For over 27 years EXPEDITIONS has been providing the most reliable, affordable transportation between the islands of Maui and Lāna'i. Local residents and visitors alike enjoy their short trip across the Auau Channel (Approximately One Hour) aboard Expeditions fast, United States Coast Guard certified vessels. Aboard Expeditions you’ll enjoy spectacular views of Maui County, including the islands of Maui, Lāna'i, Molokaʻi and Kahoʻolawe.
